{{translated title}} ---- [[File:The Competitive Piplup and the Stubborn Novelist.png|thumb|250px|The Competitive Piplup and the Stubborn Novelist]] (Japanese: '''{{j|負けず嫌いなポッチャマとがんこな小説家}}''' ''The Competitive {{tt|Pochama|Piplup}} and the Stubborn Novelist'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] written by {{j|森もり子}} ''Moriko Mori'' and illustrated by {{j|トミムラコタ}} ''Cota Tomimura''. It was published weekly on the official [[Project Piplup]] X (Twitter) account from August 25 to October 27, 2021. Each chapter is four pages long. It was announced on August 24, 2021.[https://twitter.com/prj_pochama/status/1430092551659401230 Manga announcement on the official Project Piplup X (Twitter) account] (Japanese) It was planned and produced by [https://minto-inc.jp/en/ wwwaap].[https://web.archive.org/web/20210922133718/https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000053.000031241.html wwwaap Press Release | PR TIMES] (Japanese; archived) ==Characters== * '''Ryūnosuke''' (Japanese: '''{{j|リュウノスケ}}''' ''Ryūnosuke''). He is a novelist. * '''Kozue''' (Japanese: '''{{j|コズエ}}''' ''Kozue''). She is Ryūnosuke's editor. ===Gallery===

It was first published on the official Project Piplup X (Twitter) account on October 27, 2021 at 6:00 PM JST.[https://twitter.com/prj_pochama/status/1453285514535215105 Chapter 10 on the official Project Piplup X (Twitter) account] (Japanese) ===Summary=== {{incomplete plot}} ===Characters=== ====Humans==== * Ryūnosuke * Kozue * Ryūnosuke's assistant * Ryūnosuke's fans ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Piplup}} * {{p|Empoleon}} {{-}} ==Videos== The manga was adapted into three videos on November 24, 2021.[https://twitter.com/prj_pochama/status/1463432200976748548 Videos announcement on the official Project Piplup X (Twitter) account] (Japanese) The first video adapts chapters 1 - 3, the second video adapts chapters 4 - 6, and the third and final video adapts chapters 7 - 10. {{Flexheader|justify-content=space-evenly}} {{YouTubeEmbed|m2Ow5hVVhAQ|@PokemonCoJp|name=ポケモン公式YouTubeチャンネル|Brilliant Diamond|Shining Pearl|caption='''Video 1'''}} {{YouTubeEmbed|Q8cdEJ9oCbk|@PokemonCoJp|name=ポケモン公式YouTubeチャンネル|Brilliant Diamond|Shining Pearl|caption='''Video 2'''}} {{YouTubeEmbed|z4HmbLF5p7o|@PokemonCoJp|name=ポケモン公式YouTubeチャンネル|Brilliant Diamond|Shining Pearl|caption='''Video 3'''}} {{Flexfooter}} ==Campaign== [[File:The Competitive Piplup and the Stubborn Novelist volume.png|thumb|200px|Physical volume]] A physical volume of the manga was given to customers who spent 3,000 yen (including tax) or more at {{OBP|Pokémon Center|store}} stores in {{pmin|Japan}} during the [https://web.archive.org/web/20220205105312/https://pokemon.jp/special/project_pochama/pochamarche/ POCHAMArche] event, from February 5 to 24, 2022.[https://twitter.com/prj_pochama/status/1489161740889640961 Campaign information on the official Project Piplup X (Twitter) account] (Japanese) ==References== {{reflist}} ==Related articles== * [[Piplup and the Bag of Beginnings]] {{-}} {{Project Manga notice}} [[Category:Manga]]
